title: Federated learning with model diversity and backup in case of disconnected client

pse.problem: Limitation in efficiently training global machine learning algorithms using multiple local datasets without exchanging sensitive data
pse.solution_function: Federated learning method trains local machine learning models at each client with locally-stored data, determines loss and updates weights. Server trains server-maintained models with updated weights sent from clients and identifies disconnected clients to send model portions from neighboring clients.
pse.solution_structure: Server maintains global machine learning models, each client has local data and local machine learning models, a client is connected to a neighboring client in case of disconnection.
pse.solution_implementation: Clients train local models, determine loss, update weights, and transfer updated weights to the server. Server trains global models with received updates and identifies disconnected clients and sends portions of models from neighbors.
pse.effect: Avoidance of sensitive data exchange while training a shared model using locally stored data
